shared_elements: low-relief carved human/divine figures in profile
figures facing one another / offering scene
staff or sceptre held by figure
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme: profile low-relief figures in a scene above/among horizontal registers of dense hieroglyph-like signs, including oval cartouche enclosures, staffs and disc motifs, rendered with identical profile-body conventions. The main difference is that A is a compact single framed scene of two confronted figures under an arched sky sign, while B is a large expanse dominated by many lines of text with a single figural group set high in one corner.
